children: The CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) is biased to retrace into a range of $12.96-3/4 to $13.04-1/2 per bushel, as a correction from $13.24 looks incomplete.
The correction is against the uptrend from $12.16-1/4. It may consist of three waves. The wave b seems to be ending around $13.17-1/4, to be reversed by a downward wave c.
A continuation of the uptrend will only be confirmed when the market breaks above $13.25-1/4. On the daily chart, one more hanging man formed on Thursday, after the one on Wednesday.
These bearish reversal patterns indicate a fall toward $12.99-1/2 again, which is pointed by a rising channel.
